text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Assembley prepares working paper on the Iraqi prisoners of war jailed in Iran.
- Vice-President visits pavilions at Baghdad trade fair.
- Education Ministry sends one million school text books to northern Iraq.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz meets with Belgian trade unionist delegation.
- Police in Mosul arrest a gang specialising in robbing cars and houses.
(The above stories except for the last were carried by THAWRA and QADISSIYA)
- National Assembley urges the world to press Iran to free Iraqi POWs.
